caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark-colored pot placed in the center of a plain, off-white or beige background. The pot has a wide, rounded body that narrows slightly toward the base and top, with a flat, short, and slightly outward-flaring rim. The surface of the pot appears smooth, with shades of brown and black used to create a sense of depth and roundness, as well as subtle highlights indicating light reflection. The drawing is rectangular, and the pot is positioned within a lightly outlined inner border. There is a small signature near the bottom right corner inside the inner border. No other objects or details are present in the composition.
title: Preserving Crock
